audit.why: Mel / Skill / Singed / Singed / Mel / Singed / Singed reads correctly against 58.87%: she owns the 950-range poke lane at 1 and the level-6 spike, Singed owns everything the proxy touches. The packet's defect line ('the chart gives Mel 6/7 stages') does not describe what is on disk — disk gives Mel two. The packet chart is stale here.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's whole level-6 plan is built on 'Mel's R reflects incoming projectiles'. Her R does not reflect anything.
audit.why: Riot Rebuttal (W): 'Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed', 38/35/33/29/26s. Riot Golden Eclipse (R): 'Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm', 120/100/80, 25000 range. So the reflect is a W she has had since level 2, on a very long cooldown, and the R is a global execute that scales with how much poke you have already eaten. A Singed playing around 'her R reflect' is dodging the wrong ability at the wrong level and is unaware of the one that actually kills him.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal is the W at 38s at rank 1; Golden Eclipse is a 120s global that hits your Overwhelm stacks from anywhere on the map.

audit.whatIsWrong: Overwhelm is never mentioned. Every point of chip Mel lands stacks it, and Golden Eclipse cashes those stacks in globally — so 'absorb the punishment' in the level 1-3 spike is loading a gun she fires at 6 from the other side of the map.
audit.why: Riot Searing Brilliance: 'When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely.' Riot Golden Eclipse: 'dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.' That reframes the whole early game: proxying is not just an income play against her, it is stack denial. Rebuttal also prevents her taking damage outright while it is up, so poison passes into a live Rebuttal are wasted.
audit.corrected: Deny Overwhelm stacks by proxying rather than soaking; do not run poison through a live Rebuttal.

edits.before: Mel's R reflects incoming projectiles and bursts on her command — never run at her on a long straight with your Insanity Potion active, or she turns your own burst back on you.
edits.after: Rebuttal is her W, not her R — a 38s barrier that stops damage and reflects projectiles. The R, Golden Eclipse, is global and cashes in every Overwhelm stack she has put on you.

edits.before: Insanity Potion makes you tankier and faster, but Mel's R reflects a concentrated burst back at you — run poison past her rather than all-in charging, and punish any pre-emptive R use.
edits.after: Insanity Potion makes you tankier, but Rebuttal (W, 38s at rank 1) stops damage and reflects projectiles, and Golden Eclipse then executes your Overwhelm stacks from anywhere on the map.

edits.before: Bait her R by never throwing a single large-damage commit — approach with poison running so she has no projectile worth reflecting
edits.after: Bait Rebuttal (W, 38s) by never throwing one big commit — approach with poison ticking so she has no projectile worth reflecting

edits.before: Land her Solar Snare zone to lock you in place and follow up with her execute zone so you cannot run-past her
edits.after: Land Solar Snare (11s) to root you, then bank Overwhelm stacks for a Golden Eclipse she can fire from anywhere

edits.before: Insanity Potion at 6 feels like a power spike but do not let it trick you into a straight all-in — Mel's R reflects incoming damage and projectiles, so any moment you run at her in a predictable line hands her a free burst reversal. The play is the same: ghost-proxy, keep poison running as you move, and force her R onto minions or small ticks rather than a concentrated burst. If she ever uses R pre-emptively on nothing, that is your two-second window to slam Mega Adhesive, Fling, and get real poison uptime. Play the cooldown, not the ego.
edits.after: Insanity Potion at 6 feels like a power spike but do not let it trick you into a straight all-in — Rebuttal, her W, blocks damage outright and reflects projectiles, so running at her in a predictable line hands her a free reversal. The play is the same: ghost-proxy, keep poison ticking as you move, and force Rebuttal onto minions rather than a real commit. It is 38s at rank 1, so a pre-emptive one is a very long window to slam Mega Adhesive, Fling, and get uptime. Her R is Golden Eclipse: global, 120s, and it scales with the Overwhelm stacks her poke has already put on you — so every stack you refuse to eat is damage she never collects.

edits.before: Two AP items on Singed and the side lane is unwinnable for Mel — her R cannot stop a poisoned root-fling sequence and she cannot match your split-push threat, so the resource war steadily bleeds out her team.
edits.after: Two AP items on Singed and the side lane is unwinnable for Mel — Rebuttal buys one barrier, not an escape from a poisoned root-fling, and she cannot match your split threat, so the resource war bleeds her team.

edits.before: Weather the poke — poison-kite him and fling the Solar Snare commit. Singed wins the Solar Snare cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — poison-kite her and fling the Solar Snare commit. Singed wins the flat 11s Solar Snare windows.

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mel's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ult-ghost-proxy is your macro weapon — farm where she is not. Golden Eclipse is global, so poke you soaked earlier still reaches you at 6.

edits.before: - Mel Solar Snare: matchup-defining — Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Mel Solar Snare 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s: her root, and the setup for everything else. - Rebuttal 38s at rank 1 blocks damage and reflects projectiles — it is her W, not her R. - Golden Eclipse 120s, global. - Insanity Potion 100s.
